hints.title: Group and Sort by Timestamp
hints.text: Group visits by username and sort each user browsing history chronologically.

hints.title: Form Distinct 3-Sequences
hints.text: For each user with at least three visits, generate all unique ordered 3-tuples of visited websites.

hints.title: Global Score and Lexicographical Comparison
hints.text: Aggregate frequency across distinct users for each 3-sequence. Find the pattern with the highest user frequency, resolving ties lexicographically.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating permutations instead of strictly ordered 3-combinations ignores timestamp constraints and balloons state size.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Generating combinations per user and recording unique sets per user avoids overcounting duplicate patterns.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should handle chronological sorting and tie-breaking lexicographically.
complexity.notes: Each user contributes at most once to any given 3-sequence.
